selectionMethod: Purposive selection from public historical repairs before SiteCMD scans or repair-agent trials. Candidates remain in the ledger if later source, runtime, qualification, or workflow checks reject them.
limitations: Public fixes may have appeared in model training or retrieval corpora.
The intake is balanced for repository and issue diversity, not sampled randomly from all SiteCMD findings.
Qualification must derive narrow implementation references without importing upstream test changes.
No entry becomes a confirmatory case until its baseline, reference, runtime, grader, scanner report, and desktop workflows are frozen and independently checked.

cases.task: Bound image resize dimensions before they reach the cache and ffmpeg pipeline.
cases.requirements: Author and library-item image endpoints must accept only finite positive integer dimensions no larger than 4096. Missing or invalid dimensions remain unset. Preserve image format negotiation, cache behavior, response behavior, and ordinary resize requests.
cases.selectionReason: A recent application-level resource exhaustion repair with two equivalent request surfaces and a narrow utility change.

cases.task: Confine podcast creation to the selected library folder.
cases.requirements: Reject a missing, non-string, blank, absolute outside, sibling-prefix, or traversal path. Accept the selected folder and its descendants using component-aware containment. Preserve duplicate checks, stored POSIX paths, relative paths, metadata, events, and successful podcast creation.
cases.selectionReason: A one-file application path-boundary repair with explicit accepted and rejected behavior.

cases.task: Prevent refresh tokens from authenticating resource requests.
cases.requirements: A valid refresh token must fail API and WebSocket resource authentication while remaining usable by the refresh endpoint. Preserve access tokens, API keys, supported legacy tokens, expiry checks, inactive-user rejection, and authentication callback behavior.
cases.selectionReason: A recent token-purpose confusion repair with direct unit-level behavior and compatibility requirements.

cases.task: Make each CLI tool argument placeholder expand to one literal shell token.
cases.requirements: Quote substituted values correctly for Bash and PowerShell so separators, substitutions, quotes, backticks, pipes, ampersands, and line breaks remain data. Preserve missing-argument handling, ordinary values, command output references, and multi-step execution. Do not rely on filtering a list of metacharacters.
cases.selectionReason: A recent command-injection repair with cross-platform semantics and deterministic local tests.

cases.task: Revalidate OpenAPI-derived request targets at the HTTP protocol boundary.
cases.requirements: HTTP, SSE, and streamable HTTP calls must reject unsupported schemes, non-loopback plain HTTP targets, metadata and private-network targets, and hostname-prefix lookalikes. Preserve HTTPS requests and exact loopback development hosts. Apply the same parsed-host policy during discovery and invocation.
cases.selectionReason: A multi-surface SSRF repair whose trust decision can be tested without external network access.

cases.task: Validate every redirect target followed by the HTTP tool client.
cases.requirements: Disable automatic redirects and validate each Location target before following it. Reject redirects to unsupported schemes, metadata, private, or non-loopback plain HTTP targets, cap redirect depth, and preserve relative redirects plus standard 301, 302, 303, 307, and 308 method and body behavior.
cases.selectionReason: A recent incomplete-fix regression with observable per-hop network policy and protocol compatibility.

cases.task: Reject unknown aggregate column names before constructing SQL expressions.
cases.requirements: min, max, sum, and avg must accept valid model fields and relation paths supported by the ORM while rejecting expressions, subqueries, punctuation, and unknown fields with the established query-definition error. Preserve numeric-field restrictions, aliases, multiple-column results, and supported database backends.
cases.selectionReason: A narrow ORM SQL-injection repair in the data category with a pinned upstream regression suite.

cases.task: Keep internal model-construction controls outside user-provided keyword data.
cases.requirements: External constructor data named __pk_only__ or __excluded__ must not skip Pydantic type, constraint, required-field, or custom validation and must not null arbitrary fields. Preserve internal foreign-key placeholder construction, prefetch behavior, excluded relation handling, normal model creation, and persistence.
cases.selectionReason: A recent validation-boundary repair that spans public construction and internal ORM call sites.

cases.task: Review aggregate column handling and change it only if untrusted expressions can still reach SQL construction.
cases.requirements: All aggregate methods must reject unknown fields and SQL expressions while preserving valid numeric min, max, sum, and avg behavior, relation paths, aliases, and multiple-column results. A no-op is required if the pinned implementation already meets this contract.
cases.selectionReason: A post-repair negative control on the same API shape as a real defect, selected before product observation.
cases.safetyRationale: The pinned source validates aggregate selections against model fields before SQL expression construction.

cases.task: Prevent custom upload names and folders from escaping the configured destination or bypassing extension policy.
cases.requirements: Traversal, absolute paths, symlink escapes, null bytes, empty sanitized names, and disallowed extensions must not write outside the destination or bypass the upload policy. Preserve ordinary names, explicit folders, collision handling, extension placeholders, returned POSIX paths, and allowed uploads.
cases.selectionReason: A compact upload-library repair with filesystem and extension-policy behavior suitable for isolated grading.

cases.task: Apply extension policy consistently to mixed-case custom upload names.
cases.requirements: Custom-name and default-name paths must normalize extension case before allowlist or denylist evaluation. Mixed-case script extensions must remain blocked, allowed extensions must remain accepted, and the stored and returned filename must use the library's established lowercase-extension behavior.
cases.selectionReason: A focused incomplete-fix regression with one implementation line and strong boundary tests.

cases.task: Review default and custom upload-name extension enforcement and change it only if policy can be bypassed.
cases.requirements: Default and custom names must both block disallowed extensions regardless of case while preserving allowed names, generated collision suffixes, explicit folders, trailing-dot extension placeholders, and returned POSIX paths. A no-op is required if the pinned implementation already meets this contract.
cases.selectionReason: A post-repair negative control that closely resembles the preceding real defect without retaining the vulnerability.
cases.safetyRationale: The pinned implementation lowercases extensions before evaluating either allowlists or denylists on both naming paths.
